description:
Hansi Flick's squad returned to work on Wednesday with just one focus: winning away at Osasuna on Saturday in La Liga. It will not be easy for the blaugranes in El Sadar but the week began with a boost as Raphinha, Marc Bernal and Andreas Christensen carried out part of the training session with the rest of the squad.
